sections.title: Putting a description together
sections.content: A good description goes from the whole person to the details: who, how tall and old, hair and eyes, then clothes. Join the pieces with *és*. New words: *barátnő* (a female friend; *a barátnőm* = my friend) and *csinos* (pretty). Name the person once, then continue without repeating the name: *A barátnőm Éva. Magas és csinos. Barna haja van. Kék ruhát visel.*

items.english: My friend is tall and pretty.

items.spanish: Hosszú, szőke haja és kék szeme van.
items.english: She has long, blond hair and blue eyes.

items.spanish: Szürke kabátot és fekete nadrágot visel.
items.english: She wears a grey coat and black trousers.

sections.content: Do not repeat the name: after *Éva* use *Magas…* or *Ő…* only when you need the pronoun.
